title: Intraperitoneal Injection in an Adult Mouse
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
materials: Intraperitoneal Injection in an Adult Mouse
Injectable substance, as described in approved IACUC protocol
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what PPE you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
Return injectable reagent to appropriate storage location.

steps.title: Verify personnel and animal eligibility
steps.instruction: Confirm that only IACUC‑approved and appropriately trained personnel are performing the procedure and that the mouse has received an intraperitoneal dose of an approved compound as specified by an IACUC protocol.

steps.title: Retrieve and confirm animal identity
steps.instruction: Retrieve the animal from its designated location, verify that the cage card number and LabTracks ID match the LabTracks task, then double‑check cage number, LabTracks ID, ear notches, sex, and tattoos against the task.

substeps.instruction: Weigh the animal or confirm the weight previously recorded on the cage card.

steps.title: Determine dose based on weight
steps.instruction: Consult the dosing chart from the Standard of Care Protocol to verify the appropriate dose for the animal’s weight.

steps.title: Prepare syringe and needle
steps.instruction: Using a sterile disposable syringe with Luer‑Lok tip and a sterile needle sized appropriately for the injection volume, prepare the syringe as follows:

substeps.instruction: If the injectable substance is in a bottle with a rubber stopper, wipe the top of the bottle with an alcohol wipe before inserting the needle.
If the substance is in a tube, use a different needle to draw up the substance plus a little extra; draw up a small amount of air, remove the first needle, and replace it with the injection needle.
Fill the syringe with the calculated amount of injectable compound plus a little extra.
Invert and flick the syringe gently to remove bubbles as necessary.
Expel any extra solution from the syringe until the exact dosing volume is achieved.

steps.title: Cap syringe for transport
steps.instruction: When transporting syringes, cap the needle using a recapper.

steps.title: Restrain mouse for injection
steps.instruction: Restrain the mouse with its abdomen facing the handler, tilt the mouse down to a 45° angle with its head toward the ground.

steps.title: Insert needle and aspirate
steps.instruction: Insert the needle at an approximately 30° angle into the mouse’s lower right abdominal quadrant to a depth of approximately 2‑3 mm, then aspirate to ensure the needle has not entered a blood vessel, the intestines, or the urinary bladder.

substeps.instruction: If any fluid is aspirated, discard the compound and repeat the procedure with a new syringe and needle.

steps.title: Deliver injectable substance
steps.instruction: If no aspirate is observed, dispense the injectable substance with moderate pressure and speed to prevent tissue damage.

steps.title: Withdraw needle and return mouse
steps.instruction: Remove the syringe/needle from the mouse and place the mouse back into its cage.

steps.title: Document injection details
steps.instruction: On the cage card and LabTracks task, record the substance, route, volume, time, and initials of the person completing the injection; if applicable, place a dosing flag behind the cage card and, if available, record the lot number of the substance.

steps.title: Return cage and verify equipment
steps.instruction: Return the cage to the originating rack and check that the QD is functioning properly.

steps.title: Clean work area
steps.instruction: Clean the work area where injections were performed with an approved disinfectant.

steps.title: Dispose of sharps and unused material
steps.instruction: Dispose of the syringe/needle in an approved biohazard sharps disposal container; do not re‑cap the needle and do not fill the container more than two‑thirds full.

substeps.instruction: Retain all expired or unused material for disposal by Stericycle or another authorized reverse distributor.

steps.title: Store non‑legend drug appropriately
steps.instruction: If the substance is not a legend drug, place it in a labeled bag and store it in a 4 °C refrigerator.
